searchText: EIPIP meeting in 2 hrs. Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86150029954?pwd=eDFLZGpXQTNTb3R0bzEwUWhFb3dCQT09 Meeting ID: 861 5002 9954 Passcode: 952677 anyone else having trouble connecting? Nope. Worked for me. 😦 Clicked link, browser page opened, it told me to download, I clicked download and then immediately cancelled, then clicked join via browser. Put in my name, joined. Took a bit to actually join and get audio connected, but it eventually worked. joined as phone You own a phone? don't tell anyone <@!642887713246150666> Let me know if there is a better way for me to participate without voice than Zoom chat. I usually don't have a mic at this hour because my household is asleep (sometimes I am as well). <@!543900561460822016> I *suspect* that the EIP is just political grandstanding and/or internet trolling given that the author hasn't returned to address your comments, despite being on Twitter talking about their contribution. If you wanted to press the issue, you could reply to https://twitter.com/JohnLilic/status/1298142560981065728 and tell them that it is unlikely anyone will take them seriously until they have a valid draft EIP. > <@!642887713246150666> Let me know if there is a better way for me to participate without voice than Zoom chat. I usually don't have a mic at this hour because my household is asleep (sometimes I am as well). <@!301186049323958275> I am glad to see you on the call, though it is at an inconvenient time for you. I read out your comments from the chatbox to share what you've to say, without using a microphone. Other than that, I think a comment in the Agenda is one of the options of sharing your thoughts. Also, I am open to a change of meeting time to increase convenience/participation, if it helps. Thank you <@!301186049323958275> and <@!543900561460822016> for actively joining the EIPIP meeting. Nah, don't worry about changing the meeting time on my account. I don't really like voice meetings anyway. 😉
